gold: Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection

selector.rationale: Erythema multiforme best explains the decisive findings of intensely pruritic skin eruption, erythema, helical thickening, and numerous small blisters without contradiction, and has the highest score among the candidates.

rejected.label: Parvovirus B19 infection
rejected.why: Although PVB19 DNA was found in lesional skin biopsy specimen, the clinical presentation is more consistent with Erythema multiforme.

rejected.label: Phototoxic reaction
rejected.why: The patient denied the use of any topical or systemic photosensitizers and standard phototesting with UV-A and UV-B was unremarkable, making this diagnosis unlikely.

rejected.label: Gianotti-Crosti syndrome
rejected.why: While Gianotti-Crosti syndrome is a possible diagnosis, Erythema multiforme has a higher score and better explains the clinical findings.
